name: site
description: The site: pages, posts, categories and templates in the harness. The public site reads published records from here.

tools.name: site.list
tools.description: List site records (pages, posts, categories, templates).

tools.name: site.read
tools.description: Read one site record by id or slug, including drafts.

tools.name: site.write
tools.description: Create or update a site record. A new record is a draft. Does not publish.

tools.name: site.publish
tools.description: Publish a record or return it to draft.

tools.name: site.layout
tools.description: Replace the widget tree of a page, post or template.

tools.name: site.template
tools.description: Insert a template into a record as a dynamic block.
